polities.name: Gades
polities.summary: Phoenician Gadir, oldest city of the West. Broke with Carthage in 206 BC and became a federate ally of Rome; its citizens received Roman citizenship from Caesar in 49 BC.

polities.name: Fregellae
polities.summary: Latin colony on the Liris founded in 328 BC; it revolted in 125 BC and was razed by the praetor Lucius Opimius.
